rule_definition: Aggregate only trades with UTC timestamps >= candle_open and < candle_close for a completed 4h OHLCV candle.
leakage_prevention: No trades at or after candle_close plus future candles are used.
failure_condition: Any trade outside the completed interval is included.
notes: Bucket boundaries must match existing 4h OHLCV candles.

rule_definition: Exclude current or incomplete 4h buckets from research features.
leakage_prevention: Prevents using partial live trade counts as if complete.
failure_condition: Bucket end time is later than latest complete source timestamp.

rule_definition: Missing or incomplete trade buckets remain missing.
leakage_prevention: Prevents stale flow being projected into future candles.
failure_condition: Any missing bucket receives prior bucket values.
notes: Feature-based trading would be blocked in future validation if missing.

rule_definition: Parse `ts` as Unix milliseconds and convert to timezone-aware UTC before bucketing.
failure_condition: Naive or local-time timestamps are used for buckets.
notes: Asia/Seoul workspace timezone must not affect candle boundaries.

rule_definition: Each bucket contains trades only for its exact `instId`.
failure_condition: Mixed instId values appear in a bucket.
notes: This is the key distinction from aggregate Rubik context.

rule_definition: A bucket is complete only if pagination proves no missing pages/trade IDs across the interval.
leakage_prevention: Avoids biased imbalance from partial trade history.
failure_condition: Pagination gaps or unresolved request errors overlap the bucket.
notes: Missing intervals must be reported by instrument and bucket.
